grammar.summary: 本课正式学习现在完成时：have been 与 have gone 的区别。

points.title: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词
points.explanation: 表示已完成且影响现在的动作，常接 already/just/never/ever。规则动词过去分词同过去式，不规则需记忆。

examples.en: I have just received a letter from my brother.
examples.cn: 我刚收到我哥哥的来信。

examples.en: He has already visited a great number of places.
examples.cn: 他已经参观了许多地方。

points.title: have been to 与 have gone to
points.explanation: have been to 表"去过（已回来）"；have gone to 表"去了（还没回来）"。Tim has been abroad for six months. 是持续状态。

examples.en: He has been there for six months.
examples.cn: 他在那里已经六个月了。
